newsitem.title: CHINA: China retail inflation seen at 3.5 pct for 1997.
newsitem.headline: China retail inflation seen at 3.5 pct for 1997.

text.p: China's benchmark retail price inflation was expected to be about 3.5 percent for the year and 1.5 percent in the third quarter, the Financial News said on Tuesday.
Retail sails of consumer goods were seen rising 17 percent year-on-year for 1997, or a real increase of 13 percent, it said quoting a forecast by the State Economic and Trade Commission.
Retail sales of consumer goods were seen reaching 669 billion yuan in the third quarter, rising by 13.7 percent compared with the year-ago period, or by 12 percent after inflation.
Retail price inflation was 0.8 percent for June alone and some officials have forecast the figure for the whole year to be about 4.0 percent, compared with 6.1 percent last year.
